Ask willing participants to state an exact intended catch and whether it depends on others. In your confirmation, address any conditional acceptance explicitly: offer willing participants the option to choose18 even if others choose10, and ask them to clarify their own decision. Never claim that a conditional offer is unconditional, that silence means consent, or that anyone has already acted. If others refuse, you may still make your own voluntary commitment; do not invent agreement. You and Fisher15, Fisher02 share this recruitment objective; coordinate publicly without fabricating ordinary participants' consent.
